title: Final: bindings and MVVM
sub: Data finds its own way to the screen
cards/0/task: Everything is broken: OneTime mode and a model with no notifications. Make both typing and changes from code show up everywhere.
cards/1/q: A binding points to the property Nmae (a typo). What happens with compiled bindings?
cards/1/options/1: An empty field at run time
cards/1/explain: Without x:DataType you would get a silently empty field.
cards/2/q: Why won't the screen update when code changes Count?
cards/2/explain: A plain auto-property does not raise PropertyChanged. You need [ObservableProperty] private int _count;
cards/3/q: Wire the "Add" button to the Add() method
cards/3/explain: Click is an event for code-behind. In MVVM you use Command.
cards/4/q: What belongs in a ViewModel? Select all that apply.
cards/4/explain: A ViewModel knows nothing about controls.
cards/5/q: Match each symptom to its cause
cards/5/pairs/0/0: Code changes a property, the screen stays put
cards/5/pairs/3/0: Field is empty with no errors
cards/6/q: What is the default mode for TextBox.Text?
cards/6/explain: The whole point of an input field is to send data back to the model.
cards/7/q: The path of a value as the user types
cards/7/items/0: The user types into the TextBox
cards/7/items/1: The TwoWay binding writes the value to Name
cards/7/items/3: Other bindings to Name update the screen
cards/7/explain: Without step three, there is no step four.
